layout.title: My account
layout.description: Your profile, sign-in security and personal data.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.description: Until you do, you won't be able to sign in again after you sign out.

email.title: Email
email.description: The address you sign in with and where we send account emails.

changeEmail.title: Change email
changeEmail.description: We'll send a confirmation link to the new address. Until you confirm it, you keep signing in with {{email}}.
changeEmail.sentDescription: We sent a confirmation link to {{email}}. Your email changes once you click it.

language.title: Language
language.description: The language of the app for you. Emails we send you use it too.
language.label: Preferred language
language.hint: Applies on every device you sign in on.

photo.title: Profile photo
photo.description: Shown next to your name across the app.
photo.hint: JPG, PNG, GIF or WebP. It's cropped to a square.
photo.dialogDescription: Choose a photo. The center is cropped to a square.

password.title: Password
password.description: Changing it signs you out on your other devices.
password.notValid: Your new password doesn't meet all the requirements yet.
password.updatedDescription: Other devices have been signed out.

twoFactor.title: Two-factor authentication
twoFactor.description: Require a code from your phone in addition to your password.
twoFactor.offHint: Add an extra layer of security to your account.
twoFactor.onHint: You'll be asked for a code when you sign in.
twoFactor.codesLow_one: Only {{count}} left. Generate new ones soon.
twoFactor.codesLow_other: Only {{count}} left. Generate new ones soon.
twoFactor.thisDeviceHint: You won't be asked for a code on this device.
twoFactor.deviceForgotten: We'll ask for a code next time on this device
twoFactor.turnOffHint: Sign in with your password only.

regenerate.title: Generate new recovery codes?
regenerate.description: Your old recovery codes will stop working.

reset.title: Reset authenticator app?
reset.description: Your current app stops working and two-factor authentication turns off until you set it up again.
reset.successDescription: Set it up again to turn two-factor authentication back on.

disable.title: Turn off two-factor authentication?
disable.description: Your account will be protected by your password only.

newCodes.title: Your new recovery codes
newCodes.description: Save them somewhere safe. Each code works once and you won't see them again.

recoveryCodes.copyFailed: Couldn't copy. Select the codes and copy them manually.

setup.saveDescription: If you lose access to your authenticator app, you can sign in with one of these. Each code works once. You won't see them again.
setup.title: Set up authenticator app
setup.description: Scan the QR code with an app like Google Authenticator, 1Password or Microsoft Authenticator.
setup.cantScan: Can't scan? Enter this key instead
setup.enterCode: Enter the 6-digit code from the app

download.title: Download your data
download.description: A JSON file with the personal data we store about you.

delete.title: Delete your account
delete.description: Permanently removes your account and signs you out. This can't be undone.
delete.dialogDescription: This permanently deletes your account. Enter your password to confirm.
